recipes.title: Shimmering Starlight Elixir
recipes.description: A luminous chilled drink said to grant clarity of mind, swirling with berries and honeyed cream.
recipes.instructions:
Yield: 2 servings | Time: 5 minutes
1. Combine the coconut milk, blueberries, and honey in a blender and blend on high until completely smooth, about 30 seconds.
2. Squeeze in the juice of the lemon and pulse for 5 seconds to combine.
3. Pour into two chilled glasses.
4. Garnish each glass with fresh mint leaves and serve immediately.
recipes.author: Feldren

recipes.title: Feldren's Molten Ember Broth
recipes.description: A fiery, warming broth that crackles on the tongue like a captured ember.
recipes.instructions:
Yield: 4 servings | Time: 25 minutes
1. Mince the garlic and ginger, then sweat them in a 4-quart pot over medium heat, stirring, until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
2. Pour in the vegetable broth and whisk in the turmeric and red pepper flakes.
3. Bring to a simmer and cook uncovered for 15 minutes, until the broth deepens in color.
4. Ladle into bowls and serve piping hot.
recipes.author: Feldren

recipes.title: Moonlit Mushroom Draught
recipes.description: A velvety mushroom brew best sipped under a full moon for maximum potency.
recipes.instructions:
Yield: 4 servings | Time: 30 minutes
1. Slice the mushrooms and saute with the minced garlic in a 3-quart pot over medium heat until deeply golden, about 8 minutes.
2. Add the vegetable broth and thyme, then simmer uncovered for 10 minutes.
3. Blend the soup with an immersion blender until smooth, then stir in the heavy cream.
4. Warm gently over low heat without letting it boil, then ladle into bowls to serve.
recipes.author: Feldren

recipes.title: Alchemist's Golden Tonic
recipes.description: A glowing amber tea believed to soothe both throat and troubled spirit.
recipes.instructions:
Yield: 1 serving | Time: 10 minutes
1. Grate the ginger and steep it with the turmeric in 1 cup of hot water in a mug for 5 minutes.
2. Strain the liquid into a clean mug, discarding the solids.
3. Stir in the honey until fully dissolved.
4. Add the juice of the lemon and a pinch of cinnamon, then sip while warm.
recipes.author: Feldren

recipes.title: Feldren's Frostfire Punch
recipes.description: A punch that tastes of frozen orchards and warm embers all at once.
recipes.instructions:
Yield: 6 servings | Time: 15 minutes plus 1 hour chilling
1. Combine the cranberry juice and the juice of the orange in a large pitcher.
2. Grate in the fresh ginger and whisk in the cinnamon and honey until dissolved.
3. Cover and chill in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour to let the flavors meld.
4. Serve over ice in tall glasses.
recipes.author: Feldren

recipes.title: Bubbling Cauldron Stew
recipes.description: A hearty stew that bubbles and pops like a wizard's brewing pot.
recipes.instructions:
Yield: 6 servings | Time: 1 hour 20 minutes
1. Pat the beef stew meat dry and sear in a 6-quart Dutch oven over medium-high heat until browned on all sides, about 8 minutes.
2. Add the carrots, cut into 1-inch pieces, and the potatoes, cut into 1-inch pieces.
3. Pour in the beef broth, stir in the thyme, and bring to a simmer.
4. Cover and cook for 1 hour, stirring occasionally, until the meat is fork-tender and the vegetables are soft.
5. Ladle into bowls and serve hot.
recipes.author: Feldren

recipes.title: Sorcerer's Emerald Brew
recipes.description: A vivid green smoothie rumored to sharpen a spellcaster's focus.
recipes.instructions:
Yield: 2 servings | Time: 5 minutes
1. Combine the spinach, avocado, and coconut milk in a blender.
2. Squeeze in the juice of the lime and add the honey.
3. Blend on high until silky smooth, about 30 seconds, scraping down the sides as needed.
4. Pour into glasses and drink right away for the brightest color.
recipes.author: Feldren

recipes.title: Feldren's Crimson Potion
recipes.description: A tart, deep red concoction said to embolden the drinker's courage.
recipes.instructions:
Yield: 2 servings | Time: 10 minutes
1. Muddle the raspberries in the bottom of a cocktail shaker or jar until crushed.
2. Add the cranberry juice, honey, and the juice of the lime.
3. Shake vigorously for 15 seconds, then strain into small glasses to remove the seeds.
4. Serve chilled.
recipes.author: Feldren

recipes.title: Enchanted Spice Draught
recipes.description: A warmly spiced milk brew that lingers on the tongue like an old spell.
recipes.instructions:
Yield: 2 servings | Time: 15 minutes
1. Warm the milk in a small saucepan over low heat, stirring occasionally.
2. Whisk in the cinnamon, cardamom, and grated ginger.
3. Simmer gently for 5 minutes, stirring often, keeping the milk just below a boil.
4. Remove from the heat, stir in the honey until dissolved, and pour into mugs to serve.
recipes.author: Feldren

recipes.title: Feldren's Midnight Brew
recipes.description: A rich, dark chocolate drink said to be favored by wizards working through the night.
recipes.instructions:
Yield: 2 servings | Time: 15 minutes
1. Heat the milk in a small saucepan over medium-low heat until steaming.
2. Whisk in the cocoa powder until fully dissolved and no lumps remain.
3. Add the chocolate chips and stir constantly until melted and glossy, about 2 minutes.
4. Remove from the heat, stir in the vanilla extract, and pour into mugs to serve steaming hot.
recipes.author: Feldren

recipes.title: Keplin's Second Breakfast Hash
recipes.description: A generous skillet hash for the hobbit who believes one breakfast is never enough.
recipes.instructions:
Yield: 4 servings | Time: 35 minutes
1. Dice the potatoes and the onion.
2. Fry the bacon in a 12-inch skillet over medium heat until crisp, about 6 minutes, then remove to a paper-towel-lined plate.
3. Add the butter to the skillet, then cook the potatoes and onion, stirring occasionally, until golden and fork-tender, about 15 minutes.
4. Crumble the bacon back into the skillet and toss to combine.
5. Make four small wells in the hash, crack in the eggs, cover, and cook until the whites are set but the yolks are still soft, about 4 minutes.
recipes.author: Keplin

recipes.title: Hobbiton Shepherd's Pie
recipes.description: A comforting layered pie beloved at every Hobbiton gathering.
recipes.instructions:
Yield: 6 servings | Time: 1 hour
1. Preheat oven to 400°F.
2. Boil the potatoes, cut into chunks, in salted water until fork-tender, about 15 minutes, then drain and mash with the butter until smooth.
3. Brown the ground beef in a 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat, about 6 minutes, then add the carrots, diced, and the peas.
4. Spread the beef mixture in an even layer in a 9x13-inch baking dish and top with the mashed potato, smoothing to the edges.
5. Bake for 25 minutes, until the top is golden and the filling is bubbling at the edges.
recipes.author: Keplin

recipes.title: Keplin's Honey Butter Biscuits
recipes.description: Flaky, golden biscuits dripping with sweet honey butter, perfect for elevenses.
recipes.instructions:
Yield: 10 biscuits | Time: 30 minutes
1. Preheat oven to 425°F.
2. Whisk together the flour and baking powder in a large bowl, then cut in the cold butter, cubed, with a pastry cutter until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
3. Stir in the milk and 2 tablespoons of the honey just until a soft dough forms; do not overmix.
4. Pat the dough out on a floured surface to 1-inch thickness and cut into rounds, placing them on a parchment-lined baking sheet.
5. Bake for 12-14 minutes, until golden on top, then brush with the remaining honey and serve warm.
recipes.author: Keplin

recipes.title: Cozy Cottage Chicken Stew
recipes.description: A gentle, hearty stew for chilly evenings by the fire.
recipes.instructions:
Yield: 6 servings | Time: 50 minutes
1. Cut the chicken into 1-inch chunks and sear in a 6-quart pot over medium-high heat until lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
2. Add the carrots, sliced, the celery, sliced, and the potatoes, cut into chunks.
3. Pour in the chicken broth and bring to a simmer.
4. Cover and cook for 30-35 minutes, until the vegetables are tender and the broth has thickened slightly.
5. Ladle into bowls and serve hot.
recipes.author: Keplin

recipes.title: Keplin's Apple Cinnamon Crumble
recipes.description: A warm, spiced fruit crumble that smells like autumn in the Shire.
recipes.instructions:
Yield: 8 servings | Time: 55 minutes
1. Preheat oven to 375°F.
2. Peel and slice the apples and toss them with the cinnamon in a 9x9-inch baking dish.
3. In a separate bowl, mix the oats, brown sugar, and softened butter with your fingers until crumbly.
4. Sprinkle the topping evenly over the apples.
5. Bake for 35-40 minutes, until the topping is golden and the filling is bubbling around the edges. Serve warm, with cream if desired.
recipes.author: Keplin

recipes.title: Fireside Mac and Cheese
recipes.description: Rich, creamy, and endlessly comforting - the ultimate hobbit hall favorite.
recipes.instructions:
Yield: 6 servings | Time: 30 minutes
1. Boil the elbow pasta in a 4-quart pot of salted water until just tender, about 8 minutes, then drain.
2. Melt the butter in the same pot over medium heat, whisk in the flour, and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
3. Slowly whisk in the milk and simmer, stirring, until thickened enough to coat the back of a spoon, about 5 minutes.
4. Remove from the heat and stir in the cheddar cheese until melted and smooth.
5. Fold the pasta into the cheese sauce and serve immediately while hot and gooey.
recipes.author: Keplin

recipes.title: Keplin's Pumpkin Bread
recipes.description: A moist spiced loaf that fills the whole smial with warmth.
recipes.instructions:
Yield: 1 loaf (10 slices) | Time: 1 hour 15 minutes
1. Preheat oven to 350°F and grease a 9x5-inch loaf pan.
2. Whisk together the pumpkin, sugar, and eggs in a large bowl until smooth.
3. Fold in the flour, cinnamon, and nutmeg just until no dry streaks remain.
4. Pour the batter into the prepared loaf pan and smooth the top.
5. Bake for 55-60 minutes, until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Cool in the pan for 10 minutes before slicing.
recipes.author: Keplin

recipes.title: Hearty Vegetable Barley Soup
recipes.description: A rustic, filling soup that sticks to your ribs after a long day of gardening.
recipes.instructions:
Yield: 6 servings | Time: 55 minutes
1. Saute the onion, diced, the carrots, diced, and the celery, diced, in a 6-quart pot over medium heat until softened, about 6 minutes.
2. Add the barley and vegetable broth and bring to a boil.
3. Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 35-40 minutes, until the barley is tender.
4. Season to taste with salt and pepper and ladle into bowls while hot.
recipes.author: Keplin

recipes.title: Keplin's Blueberry Pancakes
recipes.description: Fluffy stacks studded with berries, best enjoyed at second breakfast.
recipes.instructions:
Yield: 12 pancakes | Time: 25 minutes
1. Whisk together the flour, milk, and eggs in a large bowl until a smooth batter forms.
2. Gently fold in the blueberries, taking care not to overmix.
3. Heat a buttered griddle over medium heat and ladle 1/4 cup of batter per pancake onto the surface.
4. Cook until bubbles form on top and the edges look set, about 2 minutes, then flip and cook 1-2 minutes more until golden.
5. Stack the pancakes and drizzle generously with maple syrup before serving.
recipes.author: Keplin

recipes.title: Sunday Roast Chicken
recipes.description: A golden, herb-roasted chicken fit for the whole extended hobbit family.
recipes.instructions:
Yield: 6 servings | Time: 1 hour 40 minutes
1. Preheat oven to 400°F.
2. Rub the whole chicken all over, including under the skin, with the softened butter, the rosemary, and the garlic, smashed.
3. Arrange the potatoes, quartered, around the chicken in a large roasting pan.
4. Roast for about 1 hour 20 minutes, until a thermometer inserted in the thickest part of the thigh reads 165°F and the skin is deep golden brown.
5. Rest the chicken for 10 minutes before carving and serve with the roasted potatoes.
recipes.author: Keplin

recipes.title: Myllarra's Forest Quinoa Salad
recipes.description: A bright, protein-rich salad gathered from sun-dappled groves.
recipes.instructions:
Yield: 4 servings | Time: 25 minutes
1. Cook the quinoa according to package directions in a 2-quart saucepan, then spread on a sheet pan to cool.
2. Dice the cucumber and halve the cherry tomatoes.
3. Toss the cooled quinoa with the cucumber, tomatoes, feta cheese, and olive oil in a large bowl.
4. Chill for at least 15 minutes before serving, or serve at room temperature.
recipes.author: Myllarra

recipes.title: Elvenwood Mushroom Risotto
recipes.description: A creamy risotto layered with earthy mushrooms from the deep woods.
recipes.instructions:
Yield: 4 servings | Time: 40 minutes
1. Slice the mushrooms and saute in half the butter in a 4-quart saucepan over medium heat until deeply golden, about 8 minutes, then set aside.
2. Melt the remaining butter in the same pan and toast the arborio rice, stirring, for 1 minute.
3. Add the warm vegetable broth one ladle at a time, stirring constantly and letting each addition absorb before adding the next, about 20 minutes total, until the rice is creamy and tender.
4. Fold in the mushrooms and parmesan cheese and serve immediately.
recipes.author: Myllarra

recipes.title: Myllarra's Sunlit Chickpea Curry
recipes.description: A fragrant curry as warm and golden as elven sunlight through the canopy.
recipes.instructions:
Yield: 4 servings | Time: 30 minutes
1. Saute the onion, diced, in a 4-quart pot over medium heat until translucent, about 5 minutes.
2. Stir in the curry powder and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
3. Add the chickpeas and coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer.
4. Cook uncovered for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened.
5. Fold in the spinach and cook just until wilted, about 2 minutes, then serve over rice.
recipes.author: Myllarra

recipes.title: Woven Vine Ratatouille
recipes.description: A colorful medley of garden vegetables braided together like woven vines.
recipes.instructions:
Yield: 6 servings | Time: 1 hour 10 minutes
1. Preheat oven to 375°F.
2. Slice the zucchini, eggplant, bell peppers, and tomatoes into thin rounds.
3. Arrange the vegetables in overlapping rows in a 9x13-inch baking dish, scattering the garlic, minced, between the layers.
4. Drizzle with olive oil, season with salt, and cover tightly with foil.
5. Bake for 45 minutes, until the vegetables are tender when pierced with a knife. Serve warm or at room temperature.
recipes.author: Myllarra

recipes.title: Myllarra's Silverleaf Salad
recipes.description: A crisp salad of silvery greens, sweet berries, and toasted nuts.
recipes.instructions:
Yield: 4 servings | Time: 10 minutes
1. Place the baby spinach in a large salad bowl.
2. Scatter the walnuts, the goat cheese, crumbled, and the dried cranberries over the top.
3. Drizzle with the balsamic vinegar and a little olive oil.
4. Toss gently to coat and serve at once.
recipes.author: Myllarra

recipes.title: Elven Lentil Stew
recipes.description: A nourishing, earthy stew simmered slowly beneath the eaves of the forest.
recipes.instructions:
Yield: 6 servings | Time: 50 minutes
1. Saute the carrots, diced, and the celery, diced, in a 4-quart pot over medium heat until softened, about 6 minutes.
2. Add the lentils, cumin, and vegetable broth and stir to combine.
3. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer uncovered for 30-35 minutes, until the lentils are tender.
4. Season to taste with salt and pepper and serve warm with crusty bread.
recipes.author: Myllarra

recipes.title: Myllarra's Roasted Root Medley
recipes.description: A rustic roast of autumn roots kissed with rosemary and golden oil.
recipes.instructions:
Yield: 6 servings | Time: 45 minutes
1. Preheat oven to 400°F.
2. Chop the sweet potatoes, the carrots, and the butternut squash into even 1-inch chunks.
3. Toss on a rimmed baking sheet with the olive oil and the rosemary sprigs.
4. Roast for 30-35 minutes, turning halfway through, until the edges are caramelized and the vegetables are fork-tender.
5. Serve warm straight from the pan.
recipes.author: Myllarra

recipes.title: Whispering Wind Pasta Primavera
recipes.description: A light, herb-flecked pasta tossed with the first vegetables of spring.
recipes.instructions:
Yield: 4 servings | Time: 25 minutes
1. Cook the fettuccine in a large pot of salted boiling water until al dente, about 10 minutes, then drain, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water.
2. Meanwhile, saute the zucchini, sliced, and the cherry tomatoes, halved, in the olive oil in a 12-inch skillet over medium heat until just tender, about 5 minutes.
3. Add the drained pasta to the skillet with a splash of the reserved pasta water and toss to combine.
4. Finish with the grated parmesan cheese and serve immediately.
recipes.author: Myllarra

recipes.title: Myllarra's Golden Tofu Stir-fry
recipes.description: Crisp golden tofu tossed with garden vegetables in a glossy sauce.
recipes.instructions:
Yield: 4 servings | Time: 25 minutes
1. Press and cube the tofu, then pan-fry in a lightly oiled 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat until golden on all sides, about 8 minutes.
2. Add the broccoli florets and the bell pepper, sliced, and stir-fry until crisp-tender, about 4 minutes.
3. Stir in the ginger, grated, and the soy sauce and toss until everything is evenly coated and glossy.
4. Serve hot over rice.
recipes.author: Myllarra

recipes.title: Elvenhome Squash Soup
recipes.description: A silky, golden soup that tastes of harvest and hearthlight.
recipes.instructions:
Yield: 6 servings | Time: 40 minutes
1. Saute the onion, diced, and the ginger, grated, in a 4-quart pot over medium heat until softened, about 4 minutes.
2. Add the butternut squash and vegetable broth and bring to a boil.
3. Reduce the heat and simmer for 20 minutes, until the squash is very soft.
4. Blend the soup with an immersion blender until completely smooth, then stir in the coconut milk.
5. Warm gently over low heat and serve hot.
recipes.author: Myllarra

recipes.title: Ghrolg's Beast Slayer Steak Bites
recipes.description: Seared chunks of beef, blackened and bold, fit for a warband's feast.
recipes.instructions:
Yield: 4 servings | Time: 20 minutes
1. Pat the beef stew meat dry and season generously with the kosher salt.
2. Heat the olive oil in a heavy 12-inch skillet over high heat until just smoking.
3. Sear the beef with the garlic, smashed, and the rosemary sprigs until deeply browned, about 2 minutes per side.
4. Rest for 5 minutes, then serve hot straight from the skillet.
recipes.author: Ghrolg

recipes.title: Warband Bacon-Wrapped Chicken
recipes.description: Smoky bacon-wrapped chicken thighs, hearty enough for a marching army.
recipes.instructions:
Yield: 6 servings | Time: 45 minutes
1. Preheat oven to 400°F.
2. Season the chicken thighs with the garlic powder and the black pepper.
3. Wrap each thigh tightly with a strip of bacon and secure with a toothpick if needed.
4. Arrange on a rimmed baking sheet and roast for 30-35 minutes, until the bacon is crisp and the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F.
5. Rest for 5 minutes before serving.
recipes.author: Ghrolg

recipes.title: Ghrolg's Roasted Root Feast
recipes.description: Charred, hearty root vegetables roasted over high heat like a battlefield fire.
recipes.instructions:
Yield: 6 servings | Time: 55 minutes
1. Preheat oven to 425°F.
2. Cut the sweet potatoes and the carrots into thick chunks.
3. Toss on a rimmed baking sheet with the olive oil, the rosemary sprigs, and the kosher salt.
4. Roast for 35-40 minutes, turning once, until charred at the edges and tender when pierced with a fork.
5. Serve piled high on a platter.
recipes.author: Ghrolg

recipes.title: Battle-Ready Egg Scramble
recipes.description: A hearty, protein-packed scramble to fuel a morning of orcish labor.
recipes.instructions:
Yield: 4 servings | Time: 20 minutes
1. Cook the bacon in a 10-inch skillet over medium heat until crisp, about 6 minutes, then remove and crumble, leaving the fat in the pan.
2. Whisk the eggs in a bowl and pour into the skillet, scrambling gently over medium-low heat until just set, about 3 minutes.
3. Fold in the spinach and the crumbled bacon and cook until the spinach wilts, about 1 minute.
4. Top with the avocado, sliced, and serve immediately.
recipes.author: Ghrolg

recipes.title: Ghrolg's Ironclad Pork Chops
recipes.description: Thick, smoky pork chops seared hard like armor plating.
recipes.instructions:
Yield: 4 servings | Time: 20 minutes
1. Rub the pork chops all over with the smoked paprika and the garlic, minced.
2. Heat the olive oil in a 12-inch skillet over high heat until shimmering.
3. Sear the chops for 4-5 minutes per side, until deeply browned and the internal temperature reaches 145°F.
4. Rest for 5 minutes before serving.
recipes.author: Ghrolg

recipes.title: Orcish Almond-Crusted Salmon
recipes.description: A crunchy, nutty crust protects tender salmon like scale armor.
recipes.instructions:
Yield: 4 servings | Time: 25 minutes
1. Preheat oven to 400°F.
2. Crush the almonds coarsely and mix with the garlic, minced, in a small bowl.
3. Press the almond mixture onto the top of each salmon fillet.
4. Place on a parchment-lined baking sheet and bake for 12-15 minutes, until the crust is golden and the fish flakes easily with a fork.
5. Squeeze the lemon over the top before serving.
recipes.author: Ghrolg

recipes.title: Ghrolg's Bonebroth Stew
recipes.description: A deep, fortifying stew simmered long and slow like a siege.
recipes.instructions:
Yield: 6 servings | Time: 1 hour 45 minutes
1. Sear the beef stew meat in a 6-quart pot over medium-high heat until browned on all sides, about 8 minutes.
2. Add the beef broth, the carrots, sliced, and the celery, sliced.
3. Bring to a simmer and cook uncovered for 1.5 hours, until the broth has reduced and thickened and the meat is very tender.
4. Serve hot in heavy bowls.
recipes.author: Ghrolg

recipes.title: Rampage Chicken Drumsticks
recipes.description: Sticky, spicy drumsticks meant to be torn apart with bare hands.
recipes.instructions:
Yield: 4 servings | Time: 45 minutes
1. Preheat oven to 400°F.
2. Toss the chicken drumsticks with the garlic, minced, the cayenne pepper, and the honey in a large bowl until evenly coated.
3. Arrange on a rimmed baking sheet and roast for 35-40 minutes, turning halfway through, until deeply caramelized and the internal temperature reaches 165°F.
4. Serve hot, while still sticky and glistening.
recipes.author: Ghrolg

recipes.title: Ghrolg's Coconut Curry Beast
recipes.description: A bold, fiery curry rich enough to fuel a rampage.
recipes.instructions:
Yield: 4 servings | Time: 30 minutes
1. Cube the chicken breast and sear in a 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat until browned, about 5 minutes.
2. Stir in the curry powder and the ginger, grated, and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
3. Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 15-20 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened slightly.
4. Serve hot, straight from the pan.
recipes.author: Ghrolg

recipes.title: Warlord's Skillet Hash
recipes.description: A rough-and-ready skillet meal built for speed between battles.
recipes.instructions:
Yield: 4 servings | Time: 30 minutes
1. Dice the sweet potatoes and parboil in salted water for 5 minutes, until just tender, then drain.
2. Brown the ground beef in a 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat with the onion, diced, and the bell pepper, diced, about 8 minutes.
3. Add the sweet potatoes and cook, stirring occasionally, until crisped at the edges, about 8 minutes.
4. Season to taste and serve straight from the skillet.
recipes.author: Ghrolg
